typeHashes.BetOffer: keccak256("BetOffer(address maker,address taker,bytes32 templateHash,bytes32 conditionId,uint8 makerOutcomeIndex,uint256 stake,uint256 loserFee,uint256 nonce,uint64 deadline)")
typeHashes.BetAcceptance: keccak256("BetAcceptance(address taker,bytes32 offerHash,uint8 takerOutcomeIndex,uint256 nonce,uint64 deadline)")
typeHashes.Permit: keccak256("Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)")

samplePermit.nonce: current BRL1 permit nonce for owner

notes: hashOffer and hashAcceptance return the full EIP-712 digest.
Permit fallback validates the permit signature, value, deadline, and expected nonce before accepting already-consumed nonce allowance.
Every signed field is covered by tamper/replay tests.
Live private keys or signatures are intentionally not committed.
